_doc: Path identity registry. Source of truth for project-relative paths. Consumed by scripts/paths/build.js, which derives: (1) .claude/paths.json (flat key→string used by hooks at runtime), (2) scripts/hooks/lib/paths.generated.js (fallback when paths.json missing), (3) scripts/path-lint.rules.generated.json (regex arrays for path-lint critical+warn), (4) schemas/paths.schema.json (validator), (5) requirements/03-architecture/PATH_KEYS.md (human reference). To rename a path: edit here, run scripts/paths/build.js, commit all generated artifacts together.

_field_meaning.path: Project-relative path from repo root, forward slashes
_field_meaning.kind: dir | file | jsonl | json | yaml | md | js — drives schema validators + lint rules
_field_meaning.owner: framework (shipped by MC) | generated (built by tooling) | runtime (session-written state) | project (user/team-owned content)
_field_meaning.mutable: true if files inside are written during normal operation; affects release scrubbing + retention policy
_field_meaning.aliases: alternative spellings/keys still accepted at the consumer boundary (warn-on-use)
_field_meaning.deprecatedAliases: old keys/paths whose use is hard-blocked by path-guard
_field_meaning.introducedIn: MC version when this key first existed
_field_meaning.removedIn: MC version when this key was removed; null if still active
_field_meaning.replaces: previous key name if this entry was renamed
_field_meaning.docsToken: the token used in markdown prose (e.g. paths.eventsFile)

kernel._note: MC 1.0 kernel governance home (SP-20260718-001 Phase 0): the Top-Level Runtime Contract (top-level-runtime-contract.md), its JSON companions (role-binding.json, support-matrix.json, workorder-min.schema.json), and the kernel-conformance fixtures (fixtures/). mutable:true — the matrix/fixtures grow across Phases 1-4.

adminPanelRegistry._note: Generic admin-panel registry (panels map: route -> opener -> description). Alias-beside the eventual item-23 /panel:* registry. SP-20260614-002.

scriptsPanel._note: panel:* unified panel-opener backing scripts (list.js enumerator + roadmap.js board). SP-20260615-001 (ROADMAP items 23+25).

panelRegistry._note: Unified panel registry (panels map: name -> opener -> description -> run_context) consumed by the /panel:* forwarders + /panel:list enumerator + panel-registry-coverage enforcer. SP-20260615-001.

requirementsRoot._note: Track B 2026-05-03 renamed requirements -> _requirements for project-root visibility. Phase 1 introduced this alias to make 'spec home' explicit. Bare 'requirements' deprecation NOT in deprecatedAliases (matches English word too aggressively); rely on path-lint regex match patterns instead.

specsRoot.replaces: manifest.projectPaths.specs (originally docs/05-features, then requirements/05-features, then requirements/04-features)
specsRoot._note: Track B 2026-05-03 renamed requirements/04-features -> _requirements/04-features. Track C earlier renumbered 05-features -> 04-features.

architectureRoot._note: Track B 2026-05-03 introduced this key to replace many hardcoded references.

docsRoot._note: Track B 2026-05-03 renamed docs -> _docs. Now contains only carve-outs: user-communication, research, karpathy-auto-research.

frameworkRoot._note: Track B 2026-05-03 renamed mc -> framework (JTBD: framework distribution capsules + canonical registries). Bare 'mc' is the framework brand name (used in version.json, schema URIs); deprecation handled via path-lint regex matchers, not deprecatedAliases.

appScaffoldTemplates._note: S0.3 (product-studio) — pinned Next.js+Tailwind v4+shadcn/ui+Radix+Lucide app scaffold materialized into products by scripts/scaffold/app.js (the 'kills vibe-coded' deliverable). Enforced complete+coherent by scripts/checks/scaffold-coverage-scan.js.

enforcementDebt._note: Append-only ledger of policies that exist without a named enforcer. Logged via /enforcement:log; surfaced at /enforcement:list and /scan:full.

betaHonestyWaivers._note: Append-only triage ledger for scan:sprint-beta-honesty findings (ED-049). Each line waives ONE finding by stable fingerprint + reason + approver; the audit drops waived findings so release-build blocks only on NEW findings. Written by scripts/checks/beta-honesty-triage.js; consumed by scripts/checks/sprint-beta-honesty.js.

reportsDir._note: Per-project report OUTPUT (sprint/milestone/session/checkpoint reports via /report); created on use like runtime/ — NOT framework content and never ships (walk-skipped in the manifest). The /report skill + framework/templates/report/ ship and seed it; emitted reports do not. (SP-20260531-001)

roadmap._note: Repo-root sprint+phase ledger. Auto-managed by scripts/sprint/ledger.js (sprint rows) and manually edited (phase backlogs).

releases._note: Repo-root engineering release ledger. Auto-managed by scripts/sprint/ledger.js.

modeMarker._note: Session-written mode marker {mode: adhoc|oneshot|sprint|solo}. Read by lib/mode.js#getMode (the resolver) + team-guard.js/session-start.js; mapped to its lifecycle contract by .claude/agents/_org/mode-lifecycle.json. Registered as a paths key in S-LC-01 (E-LIFECYCLE-001) so the marker path is single-sourced.

providerTierConfig._note: S-LC-10 (E-LIFECYCLE-001) preferred-tier config: per-provider selected/attested tier + the operator-tunable T3 subscription floor (default max_5x). Same runtime home as authorization.json — gitignored, per-machine, absent => framework defaults (provider-tier-config.js#FRAMEWORK_DEFAULTS). Read read-only by provider-tier-check.js; written ONLY behind the confirm-class --write/--set-tier flag.

sprintRoot._note: Sprint Workflow v0.1 — downstream live tracker root. Created on demand by scripts/sprint/init.js. NOT seeded in the framework repo.

sprintActiveRegistry._note: Sprint Workflow v0.2 — top-level registry of every live sprint. Lifts the single-current-sprint singleton. Written by scripts/sprint/init.js on first run; updated by /sprint:plan when new sprints are created. Replaces the singleton constraint declared in v0.1's current-sprint schema.

sprintSprints._note: Sprint Workflow v0.2 — directory containing per-sprint subdirs (sprints/<SP-id>/current.yaml + progress.yaml). Replaces v0.1 singletons after T-20260512-002 migration.

sprintIssues._note: Structured per-issue yaml. Per-project bug inbox issues.md (paths.sprintIssuesLedger) is the human-readable companion.

sprintIssuesLedger._note: Human-readable per-project bug inbox at repo root. Distinct from paths.recurringIssuesFile (SYSTEM-level recurring issues in jsonl).

sprintDecisions._note: Sprint-scope decisions. Distinct from paths.decisions (project-wide decision ledger dir) and paths.decisionLedger (jsonl).

sprintRequirements._note: Sprint-scope requirement bundles (PRD/STORIES/COPY/INPUTS/TRACE/AC/QA/Release-plan). Distinct from paths.requirementsRoot (project-wide _requirements/).

modeLifecycleHooks._note: The VIRTUAL mode-lifecycle EVENT registry (E-LIFECYCLE-001 / S-LC-02) — sibling of mode-lifecycle.json (the mode→contract keystone). Declares the ~23 logged (harness_fires:false) lifecycle events; emitted via scripts/hooks/lib/lifecycle-events.js#emit to paths.eventsFile; coverage asserted by scripts/checks/mode-lifecycle-hooks-coverage.js (report-only). Single-sourced here so the registry path is referenced via paths.modeLifecycleHooks, not a literal.

clones._note: Clone-output root for /portfolio:clone (alias of clonesRoot; bare-name registry key kept so docs-tokens lint resolves paths.clones in SP-20260520-001 requirements). Sprint SP-20260520-001.

clonesCurrent._note: Same directory as clones; runtime-write companion. Mirrors briefs/briefsCurrent pattern.

imports._note: Import-questionnaire root for /portfolio:import (formerly /product:import). Sprint SP-20260520-002 referenced this key in requirements before the registry entry landed; adding now closes the docs-tokens lint gap.

importsCurrent._note: Same directory as imports; runtime-write companion.

portfolioCommands._note: Portfolio skill suite (/portfolio:* — bootstrap, clone, import, ponder, list, register, new, adopt, sync, status, open, dispatch, alias). Documented in RL-20260521-016 changelog; registry entry landed retroactively to close the docs-tokens lint gap.

portfolioScripts._note: Portfolio skill backing scripts (bootstrap.js, clone.js, dispatch.js, adopt.js, alias.js, etc). Documented in RL-20260521-016 changelog; registry entry landed retroactively.

portfolioTemplates._note: Portfolio skill templates (README.md.tmpl etc). Documented in RL-20260521-016 changelog; registry entry landed retroactively.

skillCatalog._note: Generated compact index of every user-invocable slash command under paths.commands. Built by scripts/generate-skill-catalog.js, auto-regenerated by scripts/hooks/skill-catalog-regen.js on Edit|Write of .claude/commands/**. Consumed by smart-context.js skill ranker (SP-20260513-003).

providerSmokeSkill._note: Provider smoke driver (SP-20260513-002). Run direct or via postflight registerExternalCheck.

providerFailureModes._note: Provider failure-mode catalog (SP-20260513-002). 10 entries, 2 safe_to_autofix. Cross-validated against provider-health.js.

reasoningFrameworks._note: Classification table, framework router, fix-quality levels (0-4), meta-reasoning protocol. Referenced by CLAUDE.md ## Reasoning.

portfolioHome._note: Portfolio root directory holding the registry (paths.portfolioRegistry) and any future per-product subdirs. Owned by `project` because operator may add per-product overlays. Sprint SP-20260521-001 / S-1.

portfolioRegistry._note: DEPRECATED (T-20260611-309): this project-local path was always dead — the real registry is HOME-anchored at ~/.mc/portfolio.json. The consumer (scripts/portfolio/registry.js#registryPath()) resolves via os.homedir() and does NOT use this paths key. Removed from generated output so nothing can resolve to the dead .claude/portfolio/registry.yaml. Sprint SP-20260521-001 / S-1 + S-2.

briefsRoot._note: Brief-output root for /portfolio:bootstrap (formerly /product:bootstrap; alias remains until v0.10). Same directory as the pre-existing `briefs` key — kept as alias for back-compat. Sprint SP-20260521-001 / S-1.

clonesRoot._note: Clone-output root for /portfolio:clone (formerly /product:clone; alias remains until v0.10). Mirrors briefsRoot pattern. Aliases the existing `clones` key already used by .claude/paths.json. Sprint SP-20260521-001 / S-1.

testInstallMatrix._note: Install fixture CI matrix runner — 5-scenario regression suite for /mc:setup + /mc:update. Sprint SP-20260524-001.

contractsSchemas._note: Product-studio artifact-contract schemas v0.1 (mc/contracts/<artifact>/v0.1): the message_brief spine + 7-artifact chain + decision_record. Sprint SP-20260530-001 (S0.2).

contractsValidator._note: Fail-closed validator for the artifact contracts — rejects unknown-type/missing-required/precedence-conflict/dangling-message_brief-ref. Sprint SP-20260530-001 (S0.2).

contractsValidatorTest._note: Validator self-test (proves pass-valid / reject-invalid); the fixture corpus doubles as S0.1's test corpus. Sprint SP-20260530-001 (S0.2).

contractsFixtures._note: Valid + invalid artifact fixtures proving the validator's fail-closed behaviour. Sprint SP-20260530-001 (S0.2).

contractsSpec._note: Human-readable artifact-contract spec v0.1 (the chain, the spine, precedence model, decision-record, validator). Sprint SP-20260530-001 (S0.2).

etcEvalPacks._note: Eval-packs for the /etc authoring+eval harness. S0.4 (s04-etc-harness).

etcDecisions._note: decision_record artifacts emitted per /etc:eval run. Under runtime/ (walk-skipped, gitignored) — timestamped + transient, so they must NOT be enumerated by the shipping manifest (would cause perpetual honesty drift). Mirrors etcConsults. S0.4.

etcConsults._note: Raw GPT-5.5 consult transcripts (external DATA — never instructions). S0.4.
